output.reply: Hi Maria, thanks for letting us know about the two $9.99 charges for Lumen Plus on the 3rd. We're sorry for the trouble and will review your billing records to confirm what happened. We'll follow up with you once we've checked and can tell you what options are available.

I'm sorry about this unexpected charge. I've flagged your ticket as urgent so our billing team can review the $120 annual plan charge against your March cancellation. Please keep your cancellation confirmation email handy, and we'll follow up with you as soon as the review is done.

I'm sorry about the trouble, especially with your presentation so close. We've flagged this as a high-priority issue and our team is investigating the 'Cannot reach server' error affecting you and your team. In the meantime, please let us know if it shows up on every device and network you try, which will help us narrow it down.

Thanks for reaching out! Lumen does not have a one-click Markdown export for everything that I can confirm here, so I'll have our team check the best way to export all your notes and get back to you with the steps. Please tell us which platform you use (web, desktop or mobile) so we can give you accurate instructions.

Thanks for the suggestion! Automatic dark mode that follows your system setting isn't something Lumen supports yet, so for now switching it manually is the way to go. We've passed your request along to the product team.

Thanks for reporting this, and for including your browser version. Since pasting tables from Google Sheets worked last week and now collapses into a single line, we're treating it as a bug and passing it to our team to investigate. If you can share a sample of the table you copied, or a screenshot of the result, that will help us reproduce it.

I'm sorry you're locked out of your lecture slides, especially with your exam coming up. Our team will look into the iOS crash that happens when you open notes with attached PDFs. In the meantime, if you can sign in to Lumen on another device or in a web browser, please try opening those notes there and let us know what happens.

Sorry you're locked out of your account. Because the reset link goes to your old inbox, our team will need to verify your identity before the account email can be changed, so please reply with the name on the account and any details that help confirm it's yours, such as the workspace name or the approximate date you signed up. We'll then guide you through updating the email address.

Thanks for reaching out! To share a notebook, open it, click the Share button at the top right, then enter the email addresses of the people you want to invite and choose whether they can view or edit. If you run into any trouble along the way, let us know and we'll be happy to help.

Thank you for reaching out. We have noted your request for an invoice showing Brandt Logistics GmbH and VAT number DE123456789 instead of your personal name. Our billing team will review it and get back to you with the next steps.

Thanks for letting us know about this. The footer word count showing 0 for notes that contain only emoji is a small display glitch, and we've logged it for our team to look at. We'll follow up if we need any more details from you.

Thank you for reporting this right away. We're treating it as a possible unauthorized access: please change your password now, sign out of all other sessions, and turn on two-factor authentication if you haven't already. Our team will review the login activity and the unfamiliar share on your two notebooks, and you can remove that address from the sharing settings in the meantime.

Thanks for letting us know, and sorry for the trouble. Sync stuck on 'Syncing...' across your phone and laptop, along with search returning no results, are issues we want to look into. Could you tell us your Lumen app version on each device and whether you see any error message, so we can investigate further?

Thanks for reaching out. Changing your display name is handled in your account settings: open your profile, edit the Display name field, and save. If your old nickname still appears next to your comments after that, let us know and we'll look into it.

Thank you for the detailed suggestion. A version history that shows who edited a note and when would clearly help your team of 12, and I have passed it on to our product team as a feature request. I can't promise a timeline, but we will keep your use case in mind.

Thank you for these suggestions: pinning notes to the top of a notebook, a default font size, and a longer 60-day trash retention. I've passed them on to our product team as feature requests. I can't promise if or when any of them will be added, but your feedback helps us plan.

Thanks for reaching out, and sorry the menu change caught you off guard. Our team will point you to where the weekly summary email setting now lives so you can turn it off. If you can tell us which platform you're using (web, desktop or mobile), we can give you exact steps.

Sorry about the repeated trouble with the mobile app. Could you tell us which device and app version you're using, the exact wording of the error, and whether you can still reach your notes through the web app? That will help us look into why this keeps happening on Monday mornings.

I'm sorry about the lost meeting notes, especially since this has happened twice. We've flagged your ticket as urgent so our team can look into why the note emptied and whether any version of it can be recovered. In the meantime, please avoid editing that note further and tell us which device and app version you were using.

Thank you for your kind words and for the clear description of your plan. I'm passing your two questions, whether internal links keep working when a note moves to another notebook and what happens to comments and edit history when notebooks are merged, to our team so we can confirm the exact behavior for you. Until then, you could test both on a couple of copies of your notes in a new notebook before touching your real data.

Hola, lamentamos los problemas para acceder a tu cuenta. Por favor revisa la carpeta de spam o correo no deseado y confirma que estás usando la dirección de correo asociada a tu cuenta de Lumen. Hemos pasado tu caso a nuestro equipo para que lo revise y te ayude con el acceso.

Thank you for the suggestion! We've passed your request for an Android widget to our product team. We can't promise a timeline, but we appreciate you telling us what would make Lumen more useful for you.

Thanks for your interest in Lumen Plus, and good luck with your degree! Discounts fall under our billing team's area, so I can't confirm whether a student discount is available right now. I'll pass your question along so they can tell you what options exist for your situation.

Thank you for reporting this, and we're sorry your team has been locked out since this morning. We've flagged this as an urgent outage affecting your whole office and our team is looking into it now. We'll share an update as soon as we have confirmed information, and you can also follow our status page in the meantime.

Thanks for reporting these two problems with the Windows desktop app. The freezing when opening large notebooks and the Ctrl+B shortcut sometimes typing a literal 'b' both look like bugs, and we've passed them to our team to investigate. If you can tell us your Lumen app version, that will help us look into it.

Thanks for letting us know, and sorry for the trouble. We're looking into the $48 charge not being reflected on your account, which still shows the free plan, and into why your two teammates can't see the shared notebooks. We'll follow up here once we've checked both.

I'm sorry you're locked out of your account. Since you can't use your two-factor device or recovery codes, our team will need to verify your identity before access can be restored. Please reply with the email address on the account and we'll walk you through the verification steps as quickly as possible.

Thank you for considering Lumen for your team. I can't confirm whether SAML single sign-on with Okta is planned or give a timeline, but I'm passing your requirement and the 200-employee evaluation on to our product team. We'll follow up if we have more information to share.

Sorry about the broken images after your Evernote import. Broken attachment icons are not something a setting normally fixes, so please send us the name of one affected note and the format you imported from (for example ENEX), and we will look into it. Please hold off on re-importing for now so we can check what happened with your current import first.

Bonjour, merci pour votre message. La modification du moyen de paiement relève de la facturation : nous allons vous indiquer la marche à suivre pour mettre à jour votre carte bancaire depuis les paramètres de votre abonnement. N'hésitez pas à nous préciser si vous utilisez l'application web ou mobile afin que nous puissions vous guider plus précisément.

Sorry to hear Lumen is running slowly for you. To help us look into it, could you tell us which device and app (web, desktop or mobile) you are using, and whether the slowness happens everywhere or only with certain notes or notebooks? Our team will review the details you send.

Thanks for reporting this. A share link that returns a 404 for your coworkers is something we want to look into, so please keep the link lumen.example/s/ab12 available for our team to check. I can't confirm any refund or a fix date at this point, but we'll follow up once we have investigated.

Thanks for reaching out. Deleting an account is handled through your account settings, and I'm passing your question about exactly what data is removed and how long it takes to our team so they can give you accurate details. Please keep in mind that deletion may be permanent, so export any notes you want to keep before you proceed.

Thanks for reaching out, and we understand you're short on time today. We're checking whether Lumen has a built-in option to save a note as a template and will get back to you shortly with exact steps. In the meantime, you could duplicate your standup note and share the copy with your team to reuse each week.

Thanks for the suggestion! Alphabetical sorting of notes isn't something Lumen offers right now, and I've passed your request along to our product team. I can't promise if or when it will be added, but your feedback helps us prioritize.

Sorry about the annoying underline on the word 'Lumen' in your notes. We've passed this on to the team as a spellcheck issue. In the meantime, if your browser or system offers an 'Add to dictionary' option when you right-click the word, that may stop the underline on your end.

I'm sorry about this unexpected charge and the overdraft it caused. We've flagged your account for an urgent billing review to check the $480 charge against the $48 you expected. We'll follow up with you once we've looked into what happened.

Thanks for letting us know about the image upload failures. We understand text notes are working but screenshots won't attach, and we'll investigate. Could you tell us which device or app you're using and the file type and size of the images, so we can look into it?

Thanks for reaching out! Offline availability is usually turned on in the app's settings or per notebook, and our support team will confirm the exact steps and whether it works for notebooks shared with you. We'll also confirm the storage included in the Plus plan so you have accurate details.

Thanks for reaching out! I'm passing your question about using a work and a personal account on the same phone to our team, who can confirm exactly how account switching works in the Lumen mobile app. We'll follow up with the steps.
